text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer! You sure are working 
hard every day♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way... are your preparations for 
the "overseas expedition" all set?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Following the 'L'Arc Representative 
Exchange Race' at the end of this month, 
the expedition will begin the next 
month—in July, to be exact."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
While staying in France, you cannot hold 
"SS Matches" even if your Star Gauge is 
full.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once we depart until our return in late 
October, "Domestic Race Entries" and "SS 
Matches" will be unavailable, so please 
keep that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. And while I'm sure they're 
currently in the middle of getting into 
top shape for the Representative Exchange 
Race...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"I expect things will get quite busy with 
special training during the expedition. 
Taking a 'Rest' now might be wise to 
ensure you have enough energy."
choice_data_list:
Indeed... I'll consider that option as 
well!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep a close eye on <chrname>'s condition and 
energy to prepare for the L'Arc Reps 
Exhibition and the actual Overseas Tour...
